source.title: Eironn - Stormsword
source.name: Eironn
source.description: A Rogue skilled at attracting enemies and working well with allies who can deal AoE damage.

skills.name: Verdant Cyclone

description.raw: Eironn combines the power of two swords and selects a tile, pulling in enemies within 2 tiles to the center. Then causes an explosion after a short delay, dealing 250% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to enemies within 2 tiles and immobilizing them for 3s. Eironn prioritizes selecting a tile with the most surrounding enemies.
active: Eironn combines the power of two swords and selects a tile, pulling in enemies within 2 tiles to the center.

skills.description_lite: Eironn summons magical swords, pulling nearby enemies to the center, dealing damage, and immobilizing them.

skills.name: Ice Spike

description.raw: Eironn slashes to deal 110% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to enemies within a 3-tile arc and reduces their Haste by 50 for 5s. Later, Eironn stabs the target, dealing 220% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to the target and enemies in a 2-tile line behind them, reducing their Magic DEF by 40% for 5s.
